BackstoryDef.title: Watchful Child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that the people who talked too much didn't last. [PAWN_pronoun] watched more than [PAWN_pronoun] spoke, remembered every face that passed through, and never mentioned what [PAWN_pronoun] noticed until it mattered.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Leader
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] leads the Railroad from behind a dozen layers of misdirection, holding the whole fractured network together by force of will. [PAWN_pronoun] has buried more agents than [PAWN_pronoun] talks about and trusts fewer people every year, but [PAWN_pronoun] has never once stopped moving synths down the line.

BackstoryDef.title: Institute Defector's Ward
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up hearing secondhand what the Institute did to people who stopped being useful to it. [PAWN_pronoun] resolved early to end up on the side that got people out, not the side that put them in a cell to begin with.

BackstoryDef.title: Second-in-Command
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the Railroad's day-to-day operations, planning dead drops and field missions with a precision that leaves no room for sentiment. [PAWN_pronoun] argues with Desdemona more than anyone else in the organization dares to, and is usually right, which doesn't make [PAWN_objective] any easier to work under.

BackstoryDef.title: Radio Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] took apart every broken radio and terminal [PAWN_pronoun] could scavenge, convinced that the wasteland's leftover tech still had secrets worth digging out. Most people found [PAWN_possessive] theories exhausting. A few found them useful.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Quartermaster
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the Railroad's gear running and its signal intercepts decoded, muttering about surveillance conspiracies half of which turn out to be true. [PAWN_possessive] gadgets have gotten agents out of tight spots more than once, even the ones that shouldn't have worked.

BackstoryDef.title: Institute Design
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was built, not born, synthesized in an Institute vat and given a combat directive instead of a childhood. What happened after [PAWN_pronoun] stopped following that directive is a subject [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't discuss.

BackstoryDef.title: Liberated Synth
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the Railroad's answer to any operation that stops being subtle. Once an Institute combat synth, now the person the Railroad sends when a dead drop turns into a firefight. [PAWN_pronoun] has no patience for anyone who still calls synths "it."

BackstoryDef.title: Street Runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up running messages between settlements for caps, learning which alleys were shortcuts and which were traps. [PAWN_pronoun] never asked what was in the sealed notes [PAWN_pronoun] carried, and that habit of not asking is what got [PAWN_objective] noticed.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Courier
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] carries Desdemona's mission briefs between safehouses, memorizing what needs memorizing and forgetting the rest on purpose. Too young to have earned anyone's trust the slow way, [PAWN_pronoun] earned it the fast way instead, by never once getting caught.

BackstoryDef.title: Settlement Watcher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up keeping lookout for a small trading settlement, learning to read strangers at a glance and trust that instinct over anything they said out loud.

BackstoryDef.title: Ticonderoga Runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] ran the Ticonderoga safehouse for years, one of the Railroad's steadiest hands until Institute coursers found the place. [PAWN_pronoun] held the door long enough for the synths inside to run. [PAWN_pronoun] didn't run with them.
